I am a Senior Researcher at the [Ragnar Frisch Centre for Economic Research](https://www.frischsenteret.no/) in Oslo. 

I am an invited researcher at [J-PAL](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/) and an affiliate of the [Development Learning Lab](https://www.devlearnlab.no/).

## Research Interests

- Health
- Education
- Development
- Information and Networks
